text.tspan: AES-256-GCM under a per-epoch room key

g.text: How an edge decides to TRUST a key

div.p: Admission ≠ identity ≠ trust. Three independent things:

ul.li: Identity — VerifySender chain-walk: "this key belongs to member M." Cryptographic, same answer on every node.
Admission — the relay allow-list: "M may use this relay." Operational, per-relay, revocable by the operator. A relay that carries you does not vouch for who you are.
Trust — the edge's own call, by one of the tiers above. Never delegated to a server.

div.p: A name is only ever a label; the pubkey is the identity. Two members may display the same name — the key is what differs.
